name: Google Transparency Report Safe Browsing status

reliability.justification: Google Safe Browsing list status: usually reliable, but a miss reads 'not on Google's lists at <time>', never 'safe' (P067 cond 5); Google verdicts count as one vote in consensus.

safebrowsing_status.title: Transparency Report /transparencyreport/api/v3/safebrowsing/status (undocumented internal endpoint behind the Site Status page)

terms.quote: Safe Browsing v4/v5 (noncommercial; v4 deprecated; Google sends commercial users to Web Risk) runs only through licence_allow or the research profile.

safebrowsing_status.notes: Binding class of P067 (A1: 'Google Safe Browsing v4/v5 = 'noncommercial' (Google Web Risk = 'license')'). Research C0160 terms 'Undocumented internal endpoint behind the public Site Status page' (rate limits unknown); legal may tighten the class to 'unknown' as an undocumented endpoint (cf. P253 for Google News RSS). P067 cond 3: the status endpoint is not automated (undocumented internal API); it becomes a manual pivot link (transparencyreport.google.com/safe-browsing/search) in the URL link pack. Used by google_safe_browsing.
safebrowsing_status.licensed_alternative: Google Web Risk (webrisk.googleapis.com, class 'license'): a company billing account recorded in licence_allow and key 'webrisk' (P067 cond 1).

notes: Seeded for batch p2-G03-1 (P067) together with the other google.com hosts. The Safe Browsing and Web Risk APIs (safebrowsing.googleapis.com, webrisk.googleapis.com; keys V3LUM_GSB_KEY/V3LUM_WEBRISK_KEY) are other providers owned by batch p2-G03-1. Undocumented endpoint: polite use (min_interval 5 s), cache 24 h.
